mechanism: Efavirenz induces CYP3A4, reducing clarithromycin plasma concentrations by 50%, while clarithromycin may inhibit efavirenz metabolism, potentially increasing efavirenz levels and CNS toxicity risk.
action: Consider alternative macrolide (azithromycin) or increase clarithromycin dose; monitor efavirenz tolerability and clarithromycin efficacy; therapeutic drug monitoring recommended if clarithromycin must be used.
